Needs changes before merge.

This is the first review of this PR. I read the whole diff and current upstream main's AGENTS.md.

What looks good:
- The existing cancellation assertions stay in place.
- Both cancellation tests passed locally, including the new six-second stall test.
- The diff changes test code and a decision record only. It changes no rendered UI, G-code, geometry, collision checks, or simulation. Screenshots and safety mutations do not apply.
- No goldens or recorded programs changed. No process file or dependency changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/basic.rs:189` — Class: unbounded test waits. The new startup loop has no deadline. If the request ends before the transport starts, `started` stays false forever. The transport's guard cannot protect this loop because `complete` never ran. Use one startup helper with `HANG_GUARD` for both cancellation tests. Make a missing start fail with a clear diagnostic.
2. PR body, `Not exercised` — Class: missing platform validation. Issue #4021 requires ten repeated runs of `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib ai_chat::basic` on Windows. The body reports macOS runs and a future Windows run. Add the Windows results for the final head, including the host and pass counts. A promised run does not meet that condition.

Results, run locally:

The trial merge is `4d9f09531e63ec8c45e61bc0ce8feafb34ef47c3`. Its first parent is this PR head. Its second parent is upstream main `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`. The tree is identical to the PR head because it already contains main.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| UI build, selected test targets | Passed |
| UI library | 1,681 passed; 7 failed; 8 ignored |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 7 passed |
| `contour_dxf_sketch` | 2 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_example` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 17 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The quick gate completed all ten steps. The library step failed only on this host's graphics adapter. I ran the same library command on bare upstream main from `crates/ui`. It gave 1,680 passed, the identical seven failures, and 8 ignored. These failures do not block this PR. No tracking issue was identified for them.

Six failures are in `egui_app::report_tests`: `a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`, `no_answer_copies_nothing`, `the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`, `the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`, `the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`, and `the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`. The seventh is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`.

The host has no usable GPU adapter. The failure text is:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

Extra suites run:
- `cargo xtask gate light`: all 6 steps passed. The motion library had 7 passed tests. Each of `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start` had 1 passed test. Total: 11 passed, 0 failed. The lane took 27 minutes, including the release build.
- No additional fixture or importer suite applies to this diff.

The first quick-gate attempt was void because I recorded the local trial merge while it built. The completed rerun above used the fixed trial merge. Builds used a separate directory under this worktree's `target/` because another Cargo process held the default directory. The cache wrapper was disabled. No runner was used.

Not run: Windows validation, full heavy lanes, safety mutations, and golden/catalog suites. This diff changes none of the code or fixtures that select the latter suites.

The review worktree and branch remain in place. No source edit, push, approval, or merge on GitHub was made.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: finding 1, the unbounded startup wait.

Both cancellation tests now use `pump_until_started` with `HANG_GUARD`.
A missing start fails with a clear diagnostic.
`startup_wait_refuses_a_transport_that_never_started` pins that diagnostic.
The mutation failed with `test did not panic as expected`. The restored fix passed.

New head: `42a1a1da69c55b72b8417271980e04fbfd56a4f9`.
On macOS host `m3`, all ten basic-suite runs passed: 70 test passes, zero failures.
Clippy passed. The catalog suite had 43 passes, zero failures, and four ignored tests.
The quick gate had ten steps: nine passed and one failed.
Its seven graphics failures match the upstream failures recorded in the latest review.

Finding 2 remains open. Both Windows hosts deny SSH authentication.
The PR body records this limitation. No Windows result is claimed.

Please re-review the startup fix. The PR stays a draft until the remaining validation is complete.

Needs changes before merge. One earlier finding remains open.

Previous findings:

1. **Fixed: unbounded startup waits.** Commit `42a1a1d` adds `pump_until_started` with `HANG_GUARD`. Both cancellation tests use it. The missing-start test checks the diagnostic. I read the fix and ran all seven `ai_chat::basic` tests ten times. All 70 tests passed on macOS host `m3`.
2. **Not fixed: Windows validation.** The author's [Addressed comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4068#issuecomment-7176528361) and body state that Windows validation remains open. Issue #4021 requires ten repeated Windows runs. macOS results do not meet that condition.

Requested before merge:

1. PR body, `Not exercised` — Class: missing platform validation. Run `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib ai_chat::basic` ten times on Windows for this final head. Record the head, host, and pass counts in the body. This is earlier finding 2, not a new finding.

No new blocker was found. I read the whole diff, the fix commit, issue #4021, and current upstream main's AGENTS.md.

What looks good:

- The existing cancellation assertions remain in place.
- Both startup waits have a deadline and a clear failure diagnostic.
- The diff changes tests and a decision record only. It changes no rendered UI. Before/after screenshots do not apply.
- It changes no G-code, geometry, collision checks, stock simulation, goldens, or recorded programs. Safety mutations do not apply.
- No process file or dependency changed.

Results, run locally on macOS host `m3`:

Trial merge: `09a840393a217466883bc9043eddd980eb2e7e34`.
First parent: PR head `42a1a1da69c55b72b8417271980e04fbfd56a4f9`.
Second parent: upstream main `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`.
The trial tree equals the PR tree because this head already contains main.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Quick gate | 10 steps completed; 9 passed; 1 failed |
| UI test build | Passed |
| UI library | 1,682 passed; 7 failed; 8 ignored |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 7 passed |
| `contour_dxf_sketch` | 2 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_example` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 17 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `ai_chat::basic`, ten sequential runs | 70 passed; 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I ran the same full UI library command on bare upstream main, from `crates/ui`, with four test threads. It had 1,680 passed, the identical seven failures, and 8 ignored. This host has no usable GPU adapter. These pre-existing failures do not block this PR. No tracking issue was identified.

The failures are six `egui_app::report_tests` cases: `a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`, `no_answer_copies_nothing`, `the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`, `the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`, `the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`, and `the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`. The seventh is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`.

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

Extra suites run:

- `cargo xtask gate light`: all 6 steps passed. The motion library had 7 passes. `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start` each had 1 pass. Total: 11 passed, 0 failed.
- No fixture or importer suite applies. No fixture, importer, post, operation, motion, or catalog file changed. Catalog and golden suites are not selected by this diff.

Mutations: none run in this review. This is not a safety-tier change. I did not change source code.

The first build attempt waited on a target lock and was stopped. The next attempt used an inherited cache wrapper and was stopped without a verdict. The completed quick gate explicitly cleared `RUSTC_WRAPPER`. Checks used `target/local-review` inside this worktree, with automatic target seeding disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

The PR is mergeable. Keep `needs-rework` for the missing Windows results. The draft state stays unchanged. The worktree and review branch remain in place. No source edit, push, approval, or GitHub merge was made.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: no additional finding was fixed in this round.

The latest review requests ten Windows runs of `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib ai_chat::basic`.
The required head is `42a1a1da69c55b72b8417271980e04fbfd56a4f9`.
The warm worktree is clean and matches that head.

Both `bacon.local` and `lenny.local` reject SSH authentication for `mikekinney`.
Each attempt returns `Permission denied (publickey,password,keyboard-interactive)`.
The fork has no registered runners. The upstream runner API returns HTTP 403.
No Windows test ran. No Windows pass count is claimed.
The PR body already records this limitation.

The accepted startup fix and its pin remain unchanged.
No source, commit, or push was needed. No gate was run again.
The recorded quick gate remains red from the seven pre-existing graphics failures.

Please re-review after the required Windows results are available.
The Windows finding remains open. The PR stays a draft.
